title: Drawing canvas app with brush, eraser and undo
when: The user wants a paint or sketch app to draw with mouse, pen or finger, pick colors and sizes, undo and save the picture.
prompt:
Goal: Smooth, sharp strokes on any screen with pointer input, unlimited undo and a PNG export.
Steps:
1. Size the canvas to its CSS box times devicePixelRatio and ctx.scale(dpr, dpr); on resize redraw from the stroke list.
2. Pointer events with setPointerCapture and touch-action: none; record strokes as { tool, color, size, points[] }.
3. Smooth with quadraticCurveTo through midpoints, round caps and joins; eraser uses globalCompositeOperation "destination-out".
4. Toolbar: labeled color input and size range, brush and eraser buttons with aria-pressed, Undo and Redo (Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z), Clear with confirm.
5. logic.mjs: history push, undo, redo (cleared by a new stroke), simplify(points, tolerance).
6. Save PNG with canvas.toBlob and a download link; autosave strokes to localStorage guarded with a size cap.
7. Canvas has role="img" and an aria-label; test.mjs covers history and simplify.
Quality bar:
- No blurry lines on high density screens.
- Pen pressure used when pointerType is pen.
- Toolbar reachable by keyboard.
Pitfalls:
- Mouse only events.
- Undo by snapshots of full images, which eats memory.
- Page scrolling while drawing on touch.
Verify:
- [ ] Controls labeled.
- [ ] Undo and redo tested.
- [ ] Export works.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js (canvas and input), logic.mjs (history, simplify), test.mjs.

examples.input: a simple paint app for my kids
examples.output: color picker, 3 sizes, eraser, undo/redo, Save PNG
